company.name: Life Sciences Key Technologies
company.shortDescription: LSK Technologies is a company that provides a low cost and an effective diagnostic device that tests Covid19 and other hundreds of diseases.
company.description: LSK is looking to tap computer vision to build disease testing hardware (a “lab in a box,” as they put it) small/fast enough to keep in a doctor’s office or workplace. The company says it’s currently running the Zika Virus field trials in Latin America and is looking at how they can bring their computer vision approach in to help tackle the COVID-19 pandemic. They also say they’ve seen over $100,000 in pre-orders to date.

aiResearchSummary.text: Life Sciences Key Technologies is focused on advancing diagnostic devices with systems for characterizing assays from multiple regions of interest. Their technology includes processing image data with at least two color channels per region, enabling precise determination of signal ratios. This approach enhances the accuracy of diagnostics for Covid19 and a wide array of diseases, ensuring low-cost and effective testing solutions.
